info.syllabusName: Truyền thông và giao tiếp trong tổ chức (Organizational Communication)
info.description:
Chapter 1: Organizational Communication: An Introduction

Chapter 2: Management Theory and Organizational Communication

Chapter 3: Theoretical Foundations: Systems, Culture, and Power

Chapter 4: Ethics and Organizational Communication

Chapter 5: Managing Information

Chapter 6: Communication Networks

Chapter 7: Culture, Climate, and Organizational Communication

Chapter 8: Meetings and Teams: Conflicts and Interventions

Chapter 9: Intercultural Communication and the Organization

Chapter 10: Crisis Communication

Chapter 11: Letter Writing

Chapter 12: Report and Proposal

Chapter 13: Online Writing

Chapter 14: Oral Communication

clos.loDetails: Provide knowledge of the major theories that have shaped the field of organizational communication

Ability to identify and analyze organizational communication problems in real workplaces bases on perspectives, theories, and concepts and and provide relevant and feasible recommendations to improve the situations.
Alility to propose an organizational communication plan
